books.title: A Day at the Farm
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Liam goes to the farm. He sees a cow, a pig, and a hen.
The cow says, 'Moo!' The pig says, 'Oink!' The hen says, 'Cluck!'
Liam feeds the hens. They peck at the corn.
Liam rides on the tractor with the farmer. It goes bump, bump, bump.
At the end of the day, Liam waves goodbye. He loves the farm.

books.title: The Little Star
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A little star lives high in the sky. Her name is Twinkle.
Every night Twinkle shines. She lights up the dark sky.
One night the moon says, 'Twinkle, you shine so bright!'
Twinkle smiles. She shines even brighter than before.
All the children look up and say, 'Look! The little star!'

books.title: Dan and the Duck
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Dan goes to the pond. He sees a yellow duck.
The duck swims to Dan. It says, 'Quack, quack!'
Dan gives the duck some bread. The duck eats it up.
The duck flaps its wings. It swims in a big circle.
Dan waves goodbye to the duck. He will come back tomorrow.

books.title: The Little Cow
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A little cow lives on a green farm. Her name is Daisy.
Daisy eats green grass all day. Munch, munch, munch!
One morning, Daisy sees a big red barn. She walks to it.
In the barn, Daisy finds a soft bed of hay. It is warm.
Daisy sleeps in the hay. She has a good nap.
